capabilities: Add accounts per AI coding service with API keys, AK/SK, subscription keys, or console cookies
Show subscription usage windows and pay-as-you-go balances grouped by service
Refresh individual cards or all accounts from the ribbon panel or command palette
Sort, expand, and collapse account cards
Export encrypted credentials across devices unlocked by a passphrase
extras: Marked as not reviewed by Obsidian; README notes several services (GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Moonshot, StepFun, PPIO, MiMo) have not been verified with real accounts, and queries are manual with no auto-polling.
motivation: The README says users with multiple subscriptions or accounts would otherwise have to check each provider's console one by one.
problem: Users subscribed to several AI coding services must open each provider's web console separately to check remaining quota and usage windows.

requires.name: account on each queried AI platform
API key or console session cookie per service

summary: Sidebar panel that aggregates subscription balances and usage for multiple AI coding platforms, with multi-account management.
